objective: Test parity-indexed destination pull (PIDP) on the frozen M699/M705 H67 ep35 S3x10 decoder payload before any RTL. The candidate is charged for its destination-pull bitmap probes and finite weight cache under the same 96-lane, eight-bank, 240-KiB, 128-B/cycle, dense-output-commit coordinate as the reconstructed A1 baselines.

resource_coordinate.weight_tile: 16 input channels x 96 output channels x 3 x 3 x INT8 = 13824 bytes
resource_coordinate.weight_refill: 32-cycle first latency plus 108 accepted 128-byte beats = 140 blocking cycles
resource_coordinate.dense_output_commit: per output-block destination: 6 local build/drain + 32 first latency + 3 beats = 41 cycles and 384 padded bytes, identical for baseline and candidate
resource_coordinate.pidp_storage: two spatial-major source rows plus all output-block Acc24 vectors plus 8192-byte control; all remaining logical bytes form a fully-associative LRU weight-tile cache

cycle_model.nature: deterministic executable fast-kill ledger, not a cycle-accurate RTL simulator
cycle_model.candidate_bias: PIDP is intentionally optimistic: bank conflicts are ignored via ceil(contributors/8), group service is only 10 cycles, descriptors and psum SRAM traffic are zero, directory clearing is removed, and no line-buffer bank conflict is charged.
cycle_model.strongest_selection: one fixed A1 point with minimum ratio-of-sums on all D0/D2/D3 records; no record/sequence/module oracle
cycle_model.a1_osg: source bits per output block + one descriptor move per contributor + two cycles per eight-descriptor bundle + 15 cycles per optimistic destination/tile K8 group + source-major cold weight refills + common dense commit + terminal/directory cycles
cycle_model.a1_sc8: same common terms, optimistic ceil(contributors/4) groups because four destination parity phases are the maximum conflict-free group
cycle_model.a1_iso8: same common terms, optimistic ceil(contributors/2) groups
cycle_model.pidp: one 128-bit source-stream cycle per input word + one 128-bit bitmap-probe cycle per parity-derived source-position word + 10 cycles per optimistic K8 group + exact finite-cache LRU weight refills + common dense commit + minimal owner transitions

exactness.contributor_topology: For every module and each of nine taps, independently generated source-forward and destination-inverse coordinate maps must be identical. Runtime active contributor counts and canonical multiset digests are bound to every record/timestep/output block.
exactness.acc24_probe: Eight deterministic destination/output-channel probes per record/timestep compare independent source-forward and destination-pull accumulation using locally derived symmetric per-output-channel INT8 weights from sealed M686 FP32 weights. This proves scheduling equivalence only; the locally quantized weights are not a checkpoint numerical admission.
exactness.d1: D1 exact {0,theta} mask and folded-theta sealed weight are diagnostic only; no D1 headline or generalized numeric-fold claim

decision_gate.traffic_go: headline cycle regression <= 5 percent (A1/PIDP >= 1/1.05) and psum+materialized-descriptor bytes reduce >= 30 percent
